verdict.reasons: Core defect: the candidate uses the large upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll as an installed irrigation component; the pressure gauge is mounted on the package itself and a small tube exits from it, implying the packaging operates as plumbing/hardware. This is explicitly disqualifying. Additional core defects: the sub-line 'Chip Nojstation Tape' under the AFP logo is gibberish and not matching the reference 'Drip Irrigation Tape' text, constituting fake/invented branding. Detail views confirm the same candidate defect. The required installed evidence (continuous header, threaded port, take-off fitting, gauge face angled away) is not matched; instead the package is the only device in the foreground.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
